Objectives and description: Objective and description: This work package involves collecting primary and secondary data, analyzing data using quantitative and qualitative methods based on the developed methodology, and interpreting findings.
Tasks:
T.3.1.Conduct surveys and interviews with eksperts
T.3.2.Collect and analyze secondary data from relevant sources
T.3.3. Consult with stakeholders and experts to validate research findings and gather additional insights.
Deliverables:
D.3.1.Completed data collection activities, including survey responses and interview transcripts
D.3.2. Apply analysis and modeling methods to develop a SWOT analysis of the blue economy.
Methodology: Qualitative research methods such as thematic analysis will be used to analyze literature and policy documents. Stakeholder consultations will involve interviews or focus groups.

dataset.description:
Objective and description: The objective of this work package is to ensure the effective coordination, monitoring, and management of all project activities to achieve the research goals within the specified timeframe and budget. This involves establishing communication channels, tracking progress, and addressing any issues that may arise during the project.
Tasks:
T.1.1. Develop a detailed project plan, including timelines and milestones
T.1.2. Monitor project progress and address any deviations from the plan
T.1.3. Ensure compliance with ethical standards and regulatory requirements
T.1.4. Prepare reports for the LU scientific committee to monitor the scientific progress of the project
Deliverables (expected results):
D.1.1. Project management plan
D.1.2. Implementation (final) report documenting achievements, challenges, and impact of the project
D.1.3. Ethical approval documentation for research activities
Methodology: Project management methodologies will be employed to ensure efficient coordination and oversight of project activities.

dataset.description:
Objectives and description: Objective and description: The objective of this work package is to development of a research methodology tailored to the specific challenges of environmental sustainability impact assessment. This includes the development of a mathematical method for water pollution assessment, the development of analytical systems, and the identification of appropriate research infrastructure and tools.
Tasks:
T.2.1.Design data collection instruments
T.2.2.Develop econometric models and analytical frameworks for assessing economic impact
T.2.3. Identify and acquire necessary research infrastructure and data sources.
Deliverables:
D.2.1.Finalized research methodology document detailing data collection procedures and analytical approaches
D.2.2. The methodology was approved by the conference and a scientific publication was prepared.
Methodology: Methodological approaches will include a combination of quantitative techniques (e.g., econometric and mathematic modeling) and qualitative methods (e.g., thematic analysis) to comprehensively assess economic impact.

distribution.title: Tasks: T.2.1.Design data collection instruments T.2.2.Develop econometric models and analytical frameworks for assessing economic impact T.2.3. Identify and acquire necessary research infrastructure and data sources.

dataset.title: WP2 Preliminary Research and Planning

dataset.description:
Objectives and description: Objective and description: The objective of this work package is to synthesize the research findings into actionable recommendations for stakeholders, and other relevant parties. It involves analyzing the data collected, identifying trends, and formulating evidence-based recommendations to address challenges and leverage opportunities.
Tasks:
T.4.1.Analyze research findings to identify key insights and trends
T.4.2.Formulate evidence-based recommendations for stakeholders
Deliverables:
D.4.1.New study course „Blue economy”
D.4.2.Analytical report or blue strategy framework summarizing key findings and trends
Methodology: Data collection methods will include surveys, interviews, and data mining techniques. Statistical analysis and modeling will be used to analyze quantitative data, while thematic analysis will be applied to qualitative data.

distribution.title: Tasks: T.4.1.Analyze research findings to identify key insights and trends. T.4.2.Formulate evidence-based recommendations for stakeholders

dataset.title: WP4 Elaboration of Recommendations

dataset.description:
Objectives and description: Objective and description: This work package focuses on disseminating research findings to relevant stakeholders and ensuring their visibility and impact. It involves preparing research findings briefs, attended dissemination events, and publishing articles in academic journals to share insights with the broader community.
Tasks:
T.5.1.Prepare research and policy briefs summarizing key findings and recommendations
T.5.2. Submit research articles to peer-reviewed journals for publication
Deliverables:
D.5.1.Dissemination materials, including research report and presentations
D.5.2.Participation in dissemination events and workshops to engage with stakeholders
D.5.3.Publish a minimum of 2 research articles in peer-reviewed journals ranked Q1 or Q2 to contribute significantly to the academic discourse, showcasing the methodology created and suggesting future research directions
D.5.4. Collaborate with project partners to prepare and submit a HORIZON project proposal, aiming to secure funding for further research and project continuation.
Methodology: Dissemination activities will utilize various communication channels, including academic conferences, workshops, and digital platforms, to reach diverse audiences and maximize impact.
